string.text: A high quality dome helmet serves as one's primary protection from psi emissions, radioactive dust and noxious chemicals. It provides limited bullet protection to the head.

This apparatus is installed inside the helmet, and automaticlly releases a healing solution into the air supply when the user is wounded, and is constantly generating calibrated elctrical pulses designed to restore stamina.
This apparatus is worn on the wrist and, when an inbuilt sensor dectects an increase of radiation in the body, automatically injects antiradiation drugs.
This suits fabric is tougher than normal, reducing the effects of damage to the other parts of the suit
This gas mask serves as one's primary protection from radioactive dust and noxious chemicals. If offers limited protection from psi emissions due to metallic components.

This titanium/aluminuim plated comabt helmet seves as ones primary protection from gunfire and shrapnel. It's builtin gas mask also protects from radioactive dust and noxious chemicals, as well as limited psi emissions.
Select parts of the suit are removed and replaced with lighter analogues to reduce weight
The suits current armor plates are removed and replaced with lighter but equally strong replacments to reduce overall weight
A psi emission helmet is installed on the inside of the hood, offering some protection from psi emissions
The fabric of the suit is saturated with a streptozoidal lotion, which speeds up the healing of wounds.
This special sealant coating can be used to seal off a suit from all known environmental anomalies.
A wire mesh installed into the suit helps to ground electrical currents.
A cooling system is installed to help maintain air temperature within the suit.
A pressurized air pump is installed into the filtering system, providing an ample supply of air to the user.
Additional Armour is inserted into the helm to offer better bullet protection.
Lightweight frame elements decreases an exoskeleton's weight.
Additional Armour plates are added to parts of the suit to offer better bullet protection.
Replacing the regular servomotors with specially designed custom ones allow the wear to run.
